payload.recallText: "Whew!" Whistled Joe as he read a letter. His sister, Clara, looked up from her own letter she was reading. "What is is Joe?" Joe was very coy about the letter's contents and didn't want to outright say what was in the letter. Clara was worried that it was serious. "Did you loose your place in the baseball league? Those people aren't good sports." Clara worried. Joe teases Clara for using a slang word, but Clara rebuts that it is not slang. Joe says he figures his pitching arm will be making him lots of money. In excitement, he swings his arm, demonstrating a proper baseball pitch. He knocks a vase over just as their mother, Mrs. Mason, enters. She asks him what in the world in going on, and he replies that he is being drafted to the major leagues. Clara and his mother are very excited. Joe leaves to meet his friends which are arriving via train. At the station, he learns that the train is delated because of bad weather.
